ng: A ng is one billionth gram.
Ng means the same as nanogram.
nga: NGA is a combat support agency that provides geographic intelligence in support of national security.
NGA means the same as National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency.
ngaio marsh: Ngaio Marsh is New Zealand writer of detective stories.
Ngaio Marsh means the same as Marsh.
nganasan: Nganasan is a member of the Samoyedic people living on the Taimyr Peninsula in Siberia.
Nganasan can also mean the Uralic language spoken by the Nganasan.
ngb: NGB is the agency that administers the Army National Guard and the Air National Guard.
NGB means the same as National Guard Bureau.
ngf: NGF is a protein that is involved in the growth of peripheral nerve cells.
NGF means the same as nerve growth factor.
ngo: NGO is an organization that is not part of the local or state or federal government.
NGO means the same as nongovernmental organization.
ngu: NGU means the same as nongonococcal urethritis.
ngultrum: A ngultrum is the basic unit of money in Bhutan.
nguni: Nguni is a group of southern Bantu languages.
nguyen tat thanh: Nguyen Tat Thanh is Vietnamese communist statesman who fought the Japanese in World War II and the French until 1954 and South Vietnam until 1975.
Nguyen Tat Thanh means the same as Ho Chi Minh.
ngwee: Ngwee is 100 ngwee equal 1 kwacha in Zambia.
